# Commands desktop build, graph task-worktree, and review UI updates

`tb-task/<uuid>/...` refs are normal shared Git refs, not unique commits by themselves. Submit no longer creates task worktrees/clones refs; `moz-phab` requires a named branch and rejects detached HEAD. [Task 2]

Scope: console.
